title: Fee Credit Allowances of the Paystride Payroll Card Program
content:
Each package of the Paystride Payroll Card Program states how many goodwill (courtesy) fee credits are allowed in any rolling 365 days, and the calendar days after a fee debit within which the employer may ask for a credit.

| Package | Courtesy fee credits allowed in any rolling 365 days | Calendar days after the fee debit to ask for a credit |
|---|---|---|
| Paystride Paycard Program Essential | 0 | 30 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Standard | 0 | 30 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Select | 1 | 60 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Advantage | 1 | 60 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Premier | 2 | 90 |
| Paystride Paycard Program Elite | 3 | 90 |

### Billing desk notes

- The Essential and Standard packages allow no courtesy credit at all.
- The allowance counts courtesy credits over a rolling 365 days, not per calendar year.
- Hypothetical reading: an Elite package program with two courtesy credits in the last 365 days is still below its allowance of 3; a Select package program with one is not below its allowance of 1.
